Explanation:

Threads belonging to the same process share the process's address space and resources.

Shared Resources across Threads:
• Global and Static Variables (Data Segment)
• Heap Memory (Dynamically allocated memory)
• Code / Text Segment
• OS Resources (Open files, I/O devices, network sockets)

Thread-Private (Unshared) Resources:
• Program Counter (PC)
• Register Set
• Stack (for local variables and call history)

Therefore, threads of a process share both heap and global variables.

Hence, option (D) is correct.
